cohort: Pregnant women (singleton pregnancy, cephalic presentation, 37-42 weeks of gestation)
finding: While epidural analgesia was an independent risk factor for operative vaginal delivery in multiparous women and increased the risk of labor complications, low 1-minute Apgar score, and low umbilical cord pH, it was not associated with low 5-minute Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Epidural analgesia was an independent risk factor for operative vaginal delivery in multiparous women.
